stories.headline: Meghyana Test May 08 2026
stories.hero-image-caption: Sister Genevieve Jeanningros (2ndL) sits with transgender women (R) who met Pope Francis, prior to a Mass on the f.
stories.content:
At least 13 people were killed and several others injured in a blast at a fireworks manufacturing unit at Mundathicode in Kerala’s Thrissur district on Tuesday afternoon, officials said.

The manufacturing unit was engaged to make fireworks for the Thrissur Pooram festival, scheduled to be held on April 26.

Among the 13 injured, the condition of six persons, including the licensee of the firework unit Satheesan,  was stated to be critical.

Fire officials and ambulance teams from nearby areas quickly responded, and the injured were rushed to nearby hospitals.

Hospital authorities said 13 bodies were received, including dismembered remains, which are being counted as individual fatalities.

The firework unit was functioning in a large area in the middle of paddy fields. Houses located more than 500m from the unit also suffered damage. Some residents suffered minor injuries in the incident.

District collector Shikha Surendran said DNA tests would be conducted to identify the bodies.
